summary: OWNER-MINER-SETUP-AGENT-FIRST-01 (owner, 2026-10-02: "yes make this more agent first and easy for an agent to automate"): miner setup is built so the miner's own agent can automate it end to end. The order is start your signer, register, who researches, inference, compute, review and launch; the miner's own agent is any MCP client and skips Inference because it uses its own model, while Hermes keeps its ready-made profile and so keeps Inference. One setup table (setup_operations.py) generates the browser's /api/v1/setup routes and the MCP carbon_setup tools, which call one perform over one set of setup records under a file lock, so the gates and their order are the same on both doors and each door sees the other's progress; a parity test fails if they drift. carbon_setup_status and GET /api/v1/setup/status return the steps done, the next step, what it is missing as closed codes and the exact next call with its arguments schema; the carbon_setup_workflow_v1 prompt states the loop. Tools follow the tiers, absent rather than refusing (C-MLP-02-D10): status, the signer check and registration in the open tier, the later steps once registration is confirmed, and launch and the research operations once review writes the profile, in the same session (open_tier.attach_operations). Starting the signer and signing the registration answer human_action_required; a model key reaches the MCP door only as model_key_file, an owner-only file the miner made. Connect snippets for Claude Code, Codex and Hermes come from each client's documentation and are marked UNVERIFIED. Compute stays link-only; DEVELOPMENT, testnet 567; nothing is qualified.
